content: Name Fls_ Config Type Kind Structure Elements Hardware dependend structure Type -- Comment Structure to hold the flash driver configuration set. The contents of the initialisation data structure are specific to the flash memory hardware. Description A pointer to such a structure is provided to the flash driver initialization routine for configuration of the driver and flash memory hardware. Available via Fls.h
